subject: Apply a multi-plane depth separation pass: analyze the spatial depth in the image, keep the dominant mid-ground subject in perfect critical focus, apply a graduated defocus to the far background (strong lens blur at maximum distance), and apply a slight foreground defocus to any elements in front of the subject plane. The depth-of-field gradient should feel natural and optically correct, as if shot with an 85mm f/1.8 prime lens. Preserve all subject color and identity perfectly.
